ai_summary: Anlon Healthcare Limited's 13th Annual General Meeting approved significant strategic moves, including a substantial increase in authorized share capital and the preferential issuance of over 85 million equity shares for non-cash consideration to acquire Apiqo Organics Private Limited and Bizotic Lifescience Private Limited. This large share-based acquisition will cause significant shareholder dilution and involves material related party transactions with the acquired entities. A key red flag is the glaring date inconsistency, with the meeting stated to occur in September 2025 but approving financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026, and the submission letter dated September 2026.
